title: Availability Zones: isolated data centers in a Region

kcs.statement: An Availability Zone is one or more discrete data centers with redundant power, networking and connectivity, located inside a Region.
Availability Zones in a Region are physically separated by a meaningful distance and do not share single points of failure, so a fire, flood or power cut in one should not take down another.
Availability Zones in the same Region are joined by redundant, low-latency, high-bandwidth private links, which makes synchronous replication between them practical.
